description: PostgreSQL 18 pg_cast catalog, coercion contexts, array recursion, assignment casts, explicit casts, and user range casts
cleanup_sql: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS type_matrix_cast_assignment CASCADE;
DROP TYPE IF EXISTS type_matrix_cast_range CASCADE;
sql: SELECT count(*) AS count FROM pg_catalog.pg_cast WHERE oid < 16384;
SELECT oid, castsource, casttarget, castfunc, castcontext::text, castmethod::text FROM pg_catalog.pg_cast WHERE oid < 16384 ORDER BY oid;
CREATE TABLE type_matrix_cast_assignment (id uuid PRIMARY KEY, n int2, label text);
CREATE TYPE type_matrix_cast_range AS RANGE (subtype = int4);

SELECT source.typname, target.typname, c.castcontext::text, c.castmethod::text, c.castfunc <> 0 AS has_function FROM pg_catalog.pg_cast AS c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_type AS source ON source.oid = c.castsource JOIN pg_catalog.pg_type AS target ON target.oid = c.casttarget WHERE source.typname = 'type_matrix_cast_range';
